milestones.label: Von Neumann formulates minimax games

milestones.work: J. von Neumann, Zur Theorie der Gesellschaftsspiele, Math. Ann. 100 (1928)
milestones.description: Von Neumann uses the minimax principle on the target class of strategic games.
milestones.note: The same article truly plays both first-statement and first-application roles.

milestones.label: EGA I states the scheme language

milestones.note: Earlier 1958 lectures and notes may contain the definition; their publication timing has not been established. EGA I truly plays both statement and consolidation roles.

milestones.label: EGA I consolidates the language

milestones.work: A. Grothendieck, EGA II: Étude globale élémentaire de quelques classes de morphismes, Publ. Math. IHÉS 8 (1961)
milestones.description: The second installment develops global classes of morphisms using the scheme framework.
